CustomField.description:
Rolls up Day 1 ARR from the quote lines. The value will then be used by Flow to populate the Day 1 ARR field. Replaces the Day 1 ARR Unadjusted field populated by CPQ price rule. Jira ticket SS-9382.
1/08/2025 - Label updated to align with Corporate ARR nomenclature. Jira ticket SS-9438
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The sum of the ARR of applicable Quote lines that are active on the first day of the term in the Quote
CustomField.label: Sales ARR Unadjusted (Rollup)
